# Sunview Wellness

> Outpatient addiction and mental health treatment center in West Palm Beach, Florida, founded in 2021. Sunview offers Partial Hospitalization (PHP), Intensive Outpatient (IOP, day or evening) and Outpatient (OP) programs for adults 18 and older, treating substance use disorders and co-occurring mental health conditions together (dual diagnosis). Outpatient only: people live at home, and Sunview helps arrange detox or 24-hour care first when it's needed. Sunview accepts Medicaid and major commercial insurance, with free benefits verification.

Key facts:
- Address: 4802 East Ave, West Palm Beach, FL 33407
- Phone: (561) 269-3175 (admissions, 24/7) · Email: info@sunviewwellness.com
- Levels of care: PHP (Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 1 PM), IOP (day or evening), OP; psychiatric evaluation and medication management through partner Telemed Clinix
- Approaches: In Vivo Treatment™, Clinical Architecture™, Internal Family Systems (IFS), inner child therapy, CBT, DBT, family and group therapy
- Individual sessions in English or Spanish; groups are in English
- Insurance: Medicaid and commercial plans including Aetna, Cigna, Florida Blue and UnitedHealthcare

## Programs

- [Outpatient Treatment Programs in West Palm Beach](https://sunviewwellness.com/programs/): Compare PHP, IOP and OP at Sunview Wellness in West Palm Beach. Hours, who each level is for, and how the Clinical Director recommends the right one.
- [Intensive Outpatient Program in West Palm Beach](https://sunviewwellness.com/programs/iop/): Day or evening intensive outpatient program in West Palm Beach for substance use and co-occurring conditions, 3 days a week, so you can keep your job.
- [Outpatient Program in West Palm Beach](https://sunviewwellness.com/programs/outpatient/): Outpatient program in West Palm Beach: one day a week, 9 AM to 1 PM, any weekday. Ongoing support after PHP or IOP while life gets back to normal.
- [Partial Hospitalization Program in West Palm Beach](https://sunviewwellness.com/programs/php/): PHP in West Palm Beach: outpatient care Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 1 PM. Sleep at home, free door-to-door transportation. Joint Commission accredited.
- [Psychiatric Care and Medication Management in West Palm Beach](https://sunviewwellness.com/programs/psychiatry-medication-management/): Psychiatric evaluation and medication management, integrated into PHP, IOP and OP through our Telemed Clinix partnership. Continuity after discharge.

## What We Treat

- [Substance Use and Mental Health Conditions We Treat in West Palm Beach](https://sunviewwellness.com/what-we-treat/): Substance use, co-occurring mental health conditions and dual diagnosis, treated together in PHP, IOP and OP in West Palm Beach.
- [Dual Diagnosis Treatment in West Palm Beach](https://sunviewwellness.com/what-we-treat/dual-diagnosis/): Integrated dual diagnosis treatment in West Palm Beach: substance use and mental health treated as one picture in PHP, IOP and OP, psychiatry included.
- [Co-Occurring Mental Health Treatment in West Palm Beach](https://sunviewwellness.com/what-we-treat/mental-health/): Depression, anxiety, trauma, bipolar and personality disorders treated alongside substance use in PHP, IOP and OP in West Palm Beach, psychiatry included.
- [ADHD and Addiction Treatment in West Palm Beach](https://sunviewwellness.com/what-we-treat/mental-health/adhd/): ADHD treated alongside substance use in West Palm Beach: structure and skills, with psychiatric care and no stimulant medications during the program.
- [Anxiety and Addiction Treatment in West Palm Beach](https://sunviewwellness.com/what-we-treat/mental-health/anxiety/): Anxiety and panic treated alongside substance use in West Palm Beach, with therapy, psychiatric support and no benzodiazepines during the program.
- [Bipolar Disorder and Addiction Treatment in West Palm Beach](https://sunviewwellness.com/what-we-treat/mental-health/bipolar-disorder/): Bipolar disorder treated alongside substance use in West Palm Beach. Outpatient care with psychiatric medication management through Telemed Clinix.
- [Depression and Addiction Treatment in West Palm Beach](https://sunviewwellness.com/what-we-treat/mental-health/depression/): Depression treated alongside substance use in West Palm Beach. Outpatient PHP, IOP and OP with therapy and psychiatric medication management.
- [Personality Disorder and Addiction Treatment in West Palm Beach](https://sunviewwellness.com/what-we-treat/mental-health/personality-disorders/): Personality disorders treated alongside substance use in West Palm Beach. DBT, IFS and psychodynamic work in outpatient PHP, IOP and OP.
- [Trauma and PTSD Treatment in West Palm Beach](https://sunviewwellness.com/what-we-treat/mental-health/trauma-ptsd/): Trauma-informed treatment for PTSD alongside substance use in West Palm Beach. Outpatient PHP, IOP and OP with psychodynamic, IFS and DBT-based care.
- [Substance Use Disorder Treatment in West Palm Beach](https://sunviewwellness.com/what-we-treat/substance-use/): Addiction treatment for alcohol, cocaine, opioids and benzos in West Palm Beach. Keep your job and sleep at home, with free door-to-door transportation.
- [Alcohol Addiction Treatment in West Palm Beach](https://sunviewwellness.com/what-we-treat/substance-use/alcohol/): Alcohol rehab in West Palm Beach: outpatient PHP, IOP and OP for adults ready to stop drinking without leaving home. Free door-to-door transportation.
- [Benzodiazepine Addiction Treatment in West Palm Beach](https://sunviewwellness.com/what-we-treat/substance-use/benzodiazepines/): Outpatient treatment for benzodiazepine dependence in West Palm Beach after medically supervised detox. PHP, IOP and OP with psychiatric care included.
- [Cocaine and Crack Addiction Treatment in West Palm Beach](https://sunviewwellness.com/what-we-treat/substance-use/cocaine/): Outpatient treatment for cocaine and crack cocaine addiction in West Palm Beach. Structured PHP, IOP and OP with therapy that goes beneath the craving.
- [Opioid Addiction Treatment in West Palm Beach](https://sunviewwellness.com/what-we-treat/substance-use/opioids/): Opioid addiction treatment in West Palm Beach after detox: PHP, IOP and OP. Suboxone and Vivitrol welcome through your prescriber.

## Therapies

- [Therapy Approaches for Addiction and Mental Health in West Palm Beach](https://sunviewwellness.com/therapies/): IFS, inner child therapy, CBT, DBT, family and group therapy, used together in outpatient addiction and dual diagnosis treatment in West Palm Beach.
- [Cognitive Behavioral Therapy in West Palm Beach](https://sunviewwellness.com/therapies/cbt/): Cognitive behavioral therapy in outpatient addiction and dual diagnosis treatment in West Palm Beach, paired with deeper work on where the patterns began.
- [Dialectical Behavior Therapy in West Palm Beach](https://sunviewwellness.com/therapies/dbt/): Dialectical behavior therapy for addiction, emotional regulation and co-occurring conditions in outpatient PHP, IOP and OP in West Palm Beach.
- [Family Therapy for Addiction Recovery in West Palm Beach](https://sunviewwellness.com/therapies/family-therapy/): Family therapy and family involvement in outpatient addiction treatment in West Palm Beach. First contact in week one, led by a systems-trained team.
- [Group Therapy for Addiction and Mental Health in West Palm Beach](https://sunviewwellness.com/therapies/group-therapy/): Group therapy in West Palm Beach with one continuous group and one facilitator every day of treatment, plus gender-specific days and honest peer feedback.
- [Inner Child Therapy in West Palm Beach](https://sunviewwellness.com/therapies/inner-child-therapy/): Inner child and psychodynamic therapy in West Palm Beach for addiction and mental health: find the why behind the behavior, then turn insight into action.
- [Internal Family Systems Therapy in West Palm Beach](https://sunviewwellness.com/therapies/internal-family-systems/): IFS therapy for addiction and dual diagnosis in West Palm Beach, integrated into group topics and individual sessions across PHP, IOP and OP.

## Blog

- [Addiction and Mental Health Recovery Blog](https://sunviewwellness.com/blog/): Articles and podcasts from Sunview Wellness CEO Frank Galimidi on In Vivo Treatment™, extended care and community-based addiction treatment.
- [Beyond Good Enough: Redefining Community-Based Care](https://sunviewwellness.com/blog/beyond-good-enough-redefining-community-based-care/): Frank Galimidi on why community-based outpatient care must be intensive, skilled and transformative, not merely adequate. Read the full article.
- [Drugs and Alcohol: It’s Worse Than You Think](https://sunviewwellness.com/blog/drugs-and-alcohol-its-worse-than-you-think/): Frank Galimidi talks with KIND Counseling about his 23-year career and how outpatient treatment lets people practice recovery at home, day or evening.
- [Getting Sober vs. Staying Sober](https://sunviewwellness.com/blog/getting-sober-vs-staying-sober/): Frank Galimidi joins Gary Garth on The elev8.io Podcast to talk about the gap between getting sober and staying sober, and why extended care matters.
- [In Vivo Treatment™ at Sunview Wellness: Recovery Has to Work in the Real World](https://sunviewwellness.com/blog/in-vivo-treatment-at-sunview-wellness-recovery-has-to-work-in-the-real-world/): Recovery skills shouldn’t just exist on paper. At some point, you have to practice them where your life actually happens.
- [Insurance companies cut patients off the moment they start doing well](https://sunviewwellness.com/blog/insurance-companies-cut-patients-off-the-moment-they-start-doing-well/): A clip from Episode 10 of The Saving Dose on why coverage so often ends right when recovery starts to take hold.
- [Recovery Centered Podcast with Tim Roberto: Why Addiction Treatment Can’t End at 28 Days](https://sunviewwellness.com/blog/recovery-centered-podcast-with-tim-roberto-why-addiction-treatment-cant-end-at-28-days/): Frank Galimidi joins Tim Roberto on the Recovery Centered Podcast on why 28 days is rarely enough and why recovery needs a stronger continuum of care.
- [Recovery Doesn’t Happen in a Bubble](https://sunviewwellness.com/blog/recovery-doesnt-happen-in-a-bubble/): Frank Galimidi on why PHP, IOP and outpatient care are where recovery is proven, because sobriety is practiced in real life, not in treatment. Read more.
- [What Actually Happens After Rehab](https://sunviewwellness.com/blog/what-actually-happens-after-rehab/): Frank Galimidi joins Dr. John Hsu and William Pedranti on The Saving Dose, Episode 10, on consequence fade, insurance-driven discharge and connection.
- [What Should a Treatment Center Feel Like?](https://sunviewwellness.com/blog/what-should-a-treatment-center-feel-like/): Clinical excellence matters, and so does recovery culture. What to pay attention to when you visit or call a program.
